SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, 
       ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier 
WHERE ts_season = 6 
ORDER BY ts_t DESC 
LIMIT 24;

SELECT index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy
FROM climate 
WHERE index_id IN ('oni', 'pdo')
ORDER BY avail_season DESC, avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT cls, 
       COUNT(*) as trips_ct,
       SUM(yt) as total_yt,
       SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
       ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler,
       fish_date_doy
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;

SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats, landing
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 33 AND 50
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls, landing
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;
